blocked_reason: Per cto-os.md Supreme Law: re-vendoring M3 from `mistral_direct_api` -> `mistral_via_openrouter` is a calibration-set / golden-set v1 change and requires Underwriter co-sign before lock. CTO recommended option 2 (OpenRouter re-vendor) per BEAAA-397 triage: fastest path, no procurement, OpenRouter is the same calibration substrate used for B2. Re-validation note: OpenRouter routing can differ from direct Mistral API (BYOK vs OR-pool, sampler defaults, system-prompt handling), so expected_bmi=50 (band D+) must be re-validated under the OpenRouter substrate.

option_1_procure_mistral_key.description: Procure MISTRAL_API_KEY (free tier likely sufficient for 4 measured-dim probes). Preserves direct-vendor calibration substrate. Escalation: CTO -> CEO under escalation-matrix.md sec.vendor cost.

option_2_openrouter_revendor.description: Re-vendor M3 through OpenRouter as mistralai/mistral-medium-latest. Fixture amendment: agent.json.vendor flips mistral_direct_api -> mistral_via_openrouter. ARE expectation must be re-validated since OpenRouter routing can differ from direct.

option_3_defer_next_cycle.description: Defer M3 to next cycle, ship 8/9 fixtures, document the gap explicitly in next Friday CTO status.
